title: Digital key and key fob usability
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on digital key recognition, iPhone sharing and setup, and dissatisfaction with the physical key fob, with many fragments too brief or context-limited to classify confidently.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unreliable digital key operation requiring updates, frustrating iPhone and Apple Watch setup, and dislike of the key fob design and usability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention key recognition issues, profile behavior, key sharing, boot access, and key availability, but the short excerpts often lack enough context to confirm sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the evidence is often too brief or incomplete for confident interpretation.
The cluster includes loosely related mentions of digital keys, physical key fobs, profile storage, boot behavior, and generic uses of the word 'key', so not all fragments reflect the same issue.
Examples are stratified samples and do not support broad conclusions about how common any specific key-related problem is.
